messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] why are we using do.enmo=TRUE, do.anglez=TRUE?
parts:
Because GGIR needs a default. ENMO is used to quantify magnitude of body acceleration, angle is used for sleep(rest) detection.
For ENMO, see also: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html#58_Why_use_data_metric_ENMO_as_default

Best, Vincent
